Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_frday number;
 temp_today number;
 temp_count number;
begin
 :avail_tiers.s_time_unit := :avail_products.s_life_span_desc;
 temp_frday := :avail_tiers.from_day * :avail_products.time_unit;
 temp_today := :avail_tiers.to_day * :avail_products.time_unit;
 --
 -- count the number of ordered products
 --
 begin
 select nvl(sum(required_qty - nvl(canceled_qty,0)
 - nvl(system_cancel_qty,0)),0)
 into :avail_tiers.s_on_order
 from order_items i
 where product_type = :avail_products.product_type
 and chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and blood_type = :ctrl_blk_0.blood_type
 and tier = :avail_tiers.tier
 and item_status in ('OR','BO','AL','PK')
 and order_no in
 (select o.order_no
 from orders o
 where order_status in ('OR','BO','AL','PK')
 and order_type in ('SP','RE','EX')
 and o.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 and o.insert_date > sysdate - 4); 
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in count - 1.1');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :s_total_on_order := :s_total_on_order + :avail_tiers.s_on_order;
 --
 -- get amounts from active products
 --
 begin
 select nvl(sum(decode(stock_state,'AL',1,0)),0),
 nvl(sum(decode(stock_state,'PK',1,0)),0),
 count(*)
 into :avail_tiers.s_allocated,
 :avail_tiers.s_packed,
 :avail_tiers.s_in_stock
 from active_products, vserv_abo
 where product_type = :avail_tiers.product_type
 and chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and abo_code = blood_type
--HCL and (blood_type = :ctrl_blk_0.blood_type
 and (blood_type in (SELECT distinct(abo_label)
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE (tested_abo_code,abo_only) in ( SELECT tested_abo_code , abo_only 
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE abo_label = :ctrl_blk_0.blood_type
 AND rownum < 2 ))
 or (:avail_products.abo_only = 'Y'
-- HCL and order_abo_group = :ctrl_blk_0.blood_type
 and order_abo_group in (SELECT distinct(abo_label)
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE (tested_abo_code,abo_only) in ( SELECT tested_abo_code , abo_only 
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE abo_label = :ctrl_blk_0.blood_type
 AND rownum < 2 ))
 ))
-- Following condition is added to ignore units with inventory class as 'AD' 
 AND inventory_class in ('RE','SP')
 and (exp_date between sysdate + temp_frday
 and sysdate + temp_today
 or (:avail_tiers.tier = :max_tier
 and exp_date > sysdate + temp_frday))
 and unit_scheme_type = decode(NVL(length(active_products.product_code), 0),5,'C','I');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in count - 1.3');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :s_total_allocated := :s_total_allocated + :avail_tiers.s_allocated;
 :s_total_packed := :s_total_packed + :avail_tiers.s_packed;
 --
 -- add them up
 :s_total_in_stock := :s_total_in_stock
 + :avail_tiers.s_in_stock;
 --
 :avail_tiers.s_available := :avail_tiers.s_in_stock
 - :avail_tiers.s_on_order;
 --
 :s_total_available := :s_total_available
 + :avail_tiers.s_available;
 hilite;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_inventory (ptype in VARCHAR2, btype in VARCHAR2) is
 --
 -- this procedure check inventory levels for a given product type and
 -- blood type. it will give a warning if there is no products in
 -- stock or if fulfilling this order will bring stock level under
 -- optimal or minimal levels.
 --
 temp_reqqty number; -- required qty
 temp_qty number; -- instock qty
 temp_optimal number := 0;
 temp_minimal number := 0;
begin
 begin
 select distinct 'X'
 into :GLOBAL.x
 from customers
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and customer_id != :orders.customer_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 return;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if ptype is null
 or btype is null
 then
 show_error_dist('0901'); -- Null parameters
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 -- get optimal level
 begin
 select sum(nvl(qty,0)) into temp_optimal
 from set_inventory_levels
 where inventory_class = :regular
 and inventory_type = :optimal
 and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and customer_id = :standard
 and product_type = ptype
 and attrib_code is null
 and ((exists (select 'x'
 from vserv_product_types
 where product_type = ptype and
 nvl(abo_only,'N') = 'Y') and
 exists (select 'x'
 from vserv_abo
 where abo_code = set_inventory_levels.blood_type
 and order_abo_group = btype)
 or
 (exists (select 'x'
 from vserv_product_types
 where product_type = ptype and
 nvl(abo_only,'N') = 'N') and
 set_inventory_levels.blood_type = btype)));
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 null;
 end;
 --
 -- get minimal level
 begin
 select sum(nvl(qty,0)) into temp_minimal
 from set_inventory_levels
 where inventory_class = :regular
 and inventory_type = :minimal
 and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and customer_id = :standard
 and product_type = ptype
 and attrib_code is null
 and ((exists (select 'x'
 from vserv_product_types
 where product_type = ptype and
 nvl(abo_only,'N') = 'Y') and
 exists (select 'x'
 from vserv_abo
 where abo_code = set_inventory_levels.blood_type
 and order_abo_group = btype)
 or
 (exists (select 'x'
 from vserv_product_types
 where product_type = ptype and
 nvl(abo_only,'N') = 'N') and
 set_inventory_levels.blood_type = btype)));
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 null;
 end;
 --
 -- get current level
 select count(*) into temp_qty
 from active_products
 where chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and product_type = ptype
 and exp_date > sysdate
 and ((exists (select 'x'
 from vserv_product_types
 where product_type = ptype and
 nvl(abo_only,'N') = 'Y') and
 exists (select 'x'
 from vserv_abo
 where abo_code = active_products.blood_type
 and order_abo_group = btype)
 or
 (exists (select 'x'
 from vserv_product_types
 where product_type = ptype and
 nvl(abo_only,'N') = 'N') and
 active_products.blood_type = btype)));
 --
 -- get required quantity
 temp_reqqty := :system.cursor_value;
 --
 if temp_qty = 0
 then
 show_error_dist('1103'); -- none in stock
 check_package_failure;
 elsif (temp_qty - temp_reqqty) < 0
 then
 show_error_dist('1104'); -- going below zero
 check_package_failure;
 elsif (temp_qty - temp_reqqty) < temp_minimal
 then
 show_error_dist('1100'); -- going below minimum
 check_package_failure;
 elsif (temp_qty - temp_reqqty) < temp_optimal
 then
 show_error_dist('1101'); -- going below optimum
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when too_many_rows
 then
 show_error_dist('0604'); -- inconsistent data
 check_package_failure;
 when others
 then
 tackle_error('Inventory');
 check_package_failure;
end;

 --

 -- leading characters of customer name, it will return the proper
 -- customer id or display a short list of matching customers
 --
 -- entry : user entry for search

 -- exclute : customer_types to be excluded
 -- check_date : set for check of valid eff date
 -- cust_id : return customer_id
 --
 days number := 0;
 inlist VARCHAR2(20);
begin

 then
return;

 --

 then
 days := 3650;

 --

 then
 inlist := 'AH,DI,EX,MG,PA,RD,RG'; -- all customer types

 --

 and nvl(term_date+days,sysdate+1);

 from customers

 and instr(inlist,customer_type) > 0
 and instr(exclude,customer_type) = 0
 and chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id

 and nvl(term_date+days,sysdate+1);
 exception

 list_values;

 check_package_failure;

declare
 temp_count number;
begin
 if :local.s_order_no is not null
 then
 validate_field_and_record;
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from order_items
 where chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and order_no = :orders.order_no
 and item_status = :ordered;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 show_error_dist('1102'); -- order canceled
 check_package_failure;
 :orders.order_status := :canceled;
 else
 :orders.order_status := :ordered;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 end if;
 clear_form(no_validate);
 GO_ITEM('orders.order_mode');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'ORDERS.CUSTOMER_ID', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('ORDERS.CUSTOMER_ID',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'ORDERS.CUSTOMER_ID', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 clear_form(no_validate);
 execute_trigger('pre-form');
 check_package_failure;
 GO_ITEM('orders.customer_id');
end;

declare

begin
 if :local.s_order_no is null
 then

 select count(*) into temp_count
 from order_items
 where chapter_id = :g_chapter_id

 then

 exception

 check_package_failure;
end;
